mcqs.question: The Vanajeevi Didi initiative for women forest guardians was launched in which location?
mcqs.explanation: Vanajeevi Didi was launched on 17 February 2026 in the Garu Range of Palamau Tiger Reserve, Jharkhand, under the PTR South Division. Latehar is associated with Palamau Tiger Reserve, while the other options do not identify the launch location.
